title: AASU Plans Statewide Protests on November 30 Over Rising Prices of Essentials

ai.summary: The All Assam Students' Union plans statewide protest marches on November 30 to demand measures to curb rising prices of essential commodities and lower market rates, accusing the government of failing to control prices and middlemen of exploiting consumers.

facts.claim: The All Assam Students' Union (AASU) will organise statewide protest marches on November 30
facts.quote: The All Assam Students' Union (AASU) will organise statewide protest marches on November 30

facts.claim: demanding measures to curb the rising prices of essential commodities and bring down market rates
facts.quote: demanding measures to curb the rising prices of essential commodities and bring down market rates

facts.claim: The protests will take place at district headquarters across Assam
facts.quote: The protests will take place at district headquarters across Assam

facts.claim: AASU president Utpal Sarma and general secretary Samiran Phukan said the unabated price rise had severely affected the common people
facts.quote: AASU president Utpal Sarma and general secretary Samiran Phukan said the unabated price rise had severely affected the common people

facts.claim: The student body accused the government of failing to control prices and alleged that the Food, Public Distribution and Consumer Affairs Department had failed to act effectively
facts.quote: The student body accused the government of failing to control prices and alleged that the Food, Public Distribution and Consumer Affairs Department had failed to act effectively

facts.claim: It also blamed middlemen for the persistent price rise and criticised the government for remaining indifferent to public grievances
facts.quote: It also blamed middlemen for the persistent price rise and criticised the government for remaining indifferent to public grievances

facts.claim: AASU said producers were struggling to receive remunerative prices while consumers were paying exorbitant rates in the market
facts.quote: AASU said producers were struggling to receive remunerative prices while consumers were paying exorbitant rates in the market

facts.claim: It urged the government to fulfil its responsibility of providing relief to the public and said the protests aimed to press for immediate action to bring down prices
facts.quote: It urged the government to fulfil its responsibility of providing relief to the public and said the protests aimed to press for immediate action to bring down prices

ai.background_note: The All Assam Students' Union is planning a statewide protest to address rising prices of essential commodities in Assam, targeting government departments and middlemen.
